source.changes: No uncommitted application or harness changes during measurement.

interpretation.change: Zoom limits now include fit-to-view scale; identical wheel inputs no longer jump to the old hard-coded 0.1 minimum.
interpretation.limitation: Camera trajectories differ from prior records. Do not attribute FPS differences to an isolated rendering optimization or claim >50 FPS acceptance.
interpretation.additionalChecks: All eight midpoints zoomed in less than 3x and returned to the starting scale within 1e-10 relative error. Final graph/entity/edge/expansion/tangle counts and selected/focused IDs match the prior projection-session matrix.
